note: Pre-release build state ONLY. Retail carries no tag and outranks every entry here. Ordering BETWEEN these is not determinable — Alpha/Beta/Proto have no consistent cross-publisher timeline. Edition/mode tokens (Alt, Arcade Mode, Trial Disc) are a different axis and live in edition.json.
compoundHeadsNote: Compound forms occur in real data: (Kiosk, GameCube), (Kiosk, E3 2003), (Kiosk, E3 1997). A comma+space list whose head is a term classifies here — which is also what stops it being mistaken for a region list of the same shape.
